supporting.quote: FIRSTLOOK processing uses the new time dependence of the Atmospheric and Surface Climatology (TASC) from the same month/previous year.

relationships.rationale: Decision step 6: the standard Level 2 Aerosol product (final ancillary inputs) from the same software version (F12_0022) covers the same orbits; RELATED.

metadata_findings: 12 existing INPUT associations copy the inputs of the global product (e.g. MIB2GEOP, MI1B2T, MI1B2E, MIRCCMF, …); by rule 1c-1 they are not inputs of the subset, whose only parent is MIL2ASAF.

8 associations write the Version without the leading zeros CMR uses, so they do not resolve: MIB2GEOP '2' (CMR: ['002', '003']), MI1B2T '3' (CMR: ['003', '004']), MI1B2E '3' (CMR: ['003', '004']), MIRCCMF '1' (CMR: ['001', '002']), MIANCARP '2' (CMR: ['002']), MIANCAGP '1' (CMR: ['001']), MIANACP '1' (CMR: ['001']), MIANTASC '2' (CMR: ['002']).
4 associations name ShortNames that are not CMR collections: MIANTOAC, MIANSMT, MIANLDBM, MICNFG.
No association to the global product it was cut from (MIL2ASAF).
